parameters.name: ChargeType
parameters.description:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:
- **PrePaid**: subscription.
- **PostPaid**: pay-as-you-go.

parameters.name: Expired
parameters.description:
The expiration status of the instance. Valid values:

* **true**: expired.
* **false**: not expired.

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description:
The IDs of the instances that you want to query.
> To specify multiple instance IDs, separate them with commas (,). You can specify up to 30 instance IDs in a single request.

parameters.name: InstanceStatus
parameters.description:
The instance status. Valid values:
* **Normal**: Normal.
* **Creating**: The instance is being created.

> For more information about instance statuses, see [Instance states and impacts](~~200740~~).

parameters.name: NetworkType
parameters.description:
The network type. Valid values:
* **VPC**: virtual private cloud (VPC). This is the default value.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value starts from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 30.

parameters.name: PrivateIp
parameters.description: The private IP address in the VPC. This parameter is deprecated.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID. This parameter can be left empty.

parameters.name: SearchKey
parameters.description: The keyword used for fuzzy search by instance name or instance ID.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The key of the tag. The key and value of a tag form a key-value pair.
> You can specify up to 5 key-value pairs of tags in a single request.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The value of the tag.
> **N** specifies the sequence number of the tag. For example, **Tag.1.Value** specifies the value of the first tag, and **Tag.2.Value** specifies the value of the second tag.
